description_en: Queries the ID of the protection rule group bound to a domain and the status of the intelligent rule hosting feature by calling DescribeDomainRuleGroup
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainRuleGroup查询域名绑定的防护规则组的ID及智能规则托管功能的启用状态
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-domain-rule-group --domain www.aliyundoc.com --instance-id waf-cn-tl32ast0000 --resource-group-id rg-aek2oij0000hbfi --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainRuleGroup

parameters.description_en:

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. Default value: empty, which indicates the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see [Create a resource group](~~94485~~).

WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见[创建资源组](~~94485~~)。
